full_name: Monica C. Bell | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Drew Gilpin Faust Fellow Yale University
bio: Monica C. Bell is a sociologist and legal scholar who writes about inequality, violence, safety, and racial justice. At Radcliffe, she will complete a book manuscript that punctuates empirical poems—poems created from coded interview transcripts—with research notes, personal stories, and images to offer insights on how Black women living in race-class subjugated neighborhoods survive and find hope under intense and arbitrary state authority.
